description: Defines the QuicServer class, a toy QUIC server implementation for testing correctness, including server setup, event handling, and configuration.

classes.name: QuicServer
classes.description: A lightweight, test-oriented QUIC server class that handles socket creation, event processing, and server configuration.

methods.name: QuicServer
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the QuicServer with various configurations.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndListen
methods.description: Starts listening on a specified address.

methods.description: Waits briefly and processes any occurring events.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Prepares server for shutdown and cleans up sessions.
